text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each enriched blend's mean absolute error minus the enriched best single product's, primary setting. A linear stack weights the single-product XGBoost models' predictions, fitted per generator on the other folds. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Planned: a comparison written into the study plan after the first science review and before the re-run that measured it. Every other row is exploratory.'
